required_input_schema.panel_pump_samples: Exact normal/superradiant pump value used in each of the five density panels.
required_input_schema.finite_chain_phase_origin: Exact lattice origin, quasiperiodic phase, and boundary used for the site-resolved profiles.
required_input_schema.branch_initialization: Initial orbital/field and continuation direction used to select the nonlinear branch.
required_input_schema.solver_protocol: Mixing, convergence norm, tolerance, iteration cap, and any branch-selection fallback.

forbidden_substitutions: source-calibrated finite-chain phase, boundary, pump, or solver settings
acceptance_boundary: Solve every density panel independently from disclosed pump and finite-chain inputs, validate normalization/convergence, then compare only as an output diagnostic.
